meta.name: postgresql-table-design
meta.description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features

copy.tagline: 设计并优化数据库表结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 PostgreSQL 工作，希望表结构既高效又规范
copy.tagline_en: Design and optimize PostgreSQL table schemas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with PostgreSQL and want clean, efficient table designs.

howto.what: 设计或审查 PostgreSQL 表时,Claude 会按既定规则给出建议,包括主键、数据类型、索引等,并指出常见错误。
howto.when: 当你要求设计或审查 PostgreSQL 的表结构时触发,例如建表、调索引或改字段类型。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户表,有主键、邮箱和注册时间。
say.note: Claude 会给出建表 SQL 和设计理由。

say.text: 审查这段建表 SQL,指出设计问题。
say.note: Claude 会逐条对照规范给出意见。

say.text: 日志数据表怎么分区?给出建表方案。
say.note: Claude 会建议按时间用 RANGE 分区。

howto.what_en: When designing or reviewing PostgreSQL tables, Claude follows a set of rules, recommending primary keys, data types, indexes, and pointing out common mistakes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design or review a PostgreSQL schema, such as creating tables, adjusting indexes, or changing column types.

say_en.text: Design a user table with primary key, email, and signup time.
say_en.note: Claude will produce the CREATE TABLE SQL and explain choices.

say_en.text: Review this CREATE TABLE SQL and point out issues.
say_en.note: Claude will check against the rules and give feedback.

say_en.text: How should I partition a log table? Give me a scheme.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest RANGE partitioning by time.
